title: HR Assistant
description:
Category: Mental Healthcare

Location:

Company Overview

Insight Therapy Solutions is a growing behavioral health organization dedicated to helping people access the care they need. Since 2012, we've combined compassionate service, strong clinical support, and operational excellence to create a positive experience for both clients and team members.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a dependable and organized HR professional who can support our day-to-day people operations and help ensure HR processes are completed accurately, efficiently, and consistently.
Position Overview

TheHR Assistantwill provide day-to-day administrative and operational support across the staff member lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, staff member records, leave and benefits coordination, performance management support, and offboarding.
This role will assist staff members, managers, and the HR team with routine HR-related needs and coordinate closely with local and international stakeholders to ensure HR processes, documentation, and requirements are completed accurately and on time.
The ideal candidate is organized, approachable, detail-oriented, discreet, and dependable, with the ability to handle confidential information, manage multiple priorities, and follow established HR processes with minimal supervision.
Key Responsibilities

Recruitment & Candidate Management

• Manage and coordinate full-cycle recruitment from job posting and sourcing through screening, interviews, candidate selection, and offer preparation, in coordination with hiring managers and HR leadership.

• Screen candidates, conduct initial interviews, coordinate interviews, and facilitate hiring team feedback.

• Maintain candidate records, recruitment trackers, and documentation in Zoho Recruit and other HR systems.

• Conduct reference checks, verifications, and required pre-engagement screening.

• Maintain timely and professional candidate communication throughout the hiring process.

Onboarding

• Prepare and coordinate contracts, NDAs, onboarding forms, and required documentation.

• Verify onboarding requirements, including references, clearances, identity verification, and other required records.

• Coordinate new staff member orientation, training, system access requests, and related communications with the appropriate departments.

• Maintain onboarding trackers and follow up on outstanding requirements.

HR Administration & Records

• Maintain accurate and confidential staff member and contractor records, HR trackers, and documentation.

• Assist with audits and ensure HR records remain complete, current, and organized.

Attendance & Benefits

• Maintain accurate attendance, PTO, and leave records

• Respond to routine inquiries regarding PTO, attendance, leave, benefits, and HR forms

• Assist with benefits administration, compensation trackers, and payroll-related HR reports.

• Coordinate routine HR requirements and documentation with Finance and benefits providers.

Performance, Engagement & Staff Relations

• Maintain performance evaluation trackers and coordinate review reminders and documentation.

• Support wellness, engagement, and retention initiatives.

• Assist with corrective action documentation and coordinate with supervisors and HR leadership on performance concerns, attendance issues, policy violations, and other staff member matters..

• Coordinate and support offboarding activities, including exit documentation, clearances, exit interviews, access removal requests, and final payment coordination.

HR Process Improvement

• Support HR process improvements, policies, templates, trackers, and documentation.

• Assist with HR projects, audits, reports, and other responsibilities assigned by the supervisor or senior management.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• At least 2 years of relevant HR, HR Associate, HR Assistant, or similar HR experience.

Think Airbnb for swimming pools, hot tubs, tennis courts, and homes by the hour!

We’re looking for a Growth Marketer who lives and breathes experimentation, someone who can spot unconventional opportunities, hack attention, and turn ideas into traction at speed.
This isn’t a “manage the funnel” job. It’s about inventing new channels, testing bold campaigns, and bending culture in Swimply’s direction. •

If you’re a hacker, builder, and cultural connector all in one, this is your role.

• 5-7+ years in growth, brand, or marketing roles with a track record of moving the needle
